**Finding: Compliant (preferred position).**

The agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Sparkling. Every occurrence of "exclusive" is neutral or favourable to us: the §2 licence grant is "non-transferable and non-exclusive", the §16(b) escrow licence over the Codes is non-exclusive, §15 addresses exclusive remedies, and §20(h) provides for non-exclusive jurisdiction. §3 (Restrictions on Use) contains only copying, assignment, reverse-engineering and protection covenants — no restriction on sourcing products or services from third parties — and §§10–11 (maintenance and fees) do not require us to take maintenance or support solely from Garman. No redline proposed.
